self_check.security: Endpoint is behind 41.1's HMAC gate (not re-reviewed here beyond the call site). Logs carry request_id and the last 4 digits only; the WhatsAppSendError text (which quotes Meta's body) is not logged by crm_send. The 502 error_title is Meta's error text passed back to the CRM, capped at 300 chars. Replay of a signed request inside the 300 s window is absorbed by the idempotency key. No new secrets; AR-1/AR-2 not affected by this change.
self_check.spec_deviation: (1) Key taken with SET NX first and GET only when NX loses, instead of GET then SET NX: justified, removes a read-then-write step, same outcomes. (2) Pre-request failure returns body {"result":"error"} with 500: spec only fixed the status; contract leaves other 5xx as 'unknown' on the CRM side, which is what the spec intended. (3) Network errors that provably never reached Meta (ConnectError) are 504 unknown and keep the placeholder: that is what both the spec table and the contract say, so not a deviation, only a conservative choice. No unjustified deviation found.

phase2.rebuttals: (a) The NX-first deviation: holds. My real-Redis run (8 concurrent threads -> one 200, seven 409, one Meta call) independently agrees with the developer's 5-thread run; the 'remove the GET branch stays green' argument for dropping the pre-GET is sound. (b) Self-decision 1 ('everything else send_raw raises, including unexpected exceptions, is 504 unknown') sits slightly against the approved plan's own decision 3 ('fails before the request reaches Meta -> DEL + 500'): an httpx error that is raised before any byte leaves (e.g. httpx.LocalProtocolError on an illegal Authorization header value from a malformed WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN, httpx.UnsupportedProtocol) is answered 504 and holds the placeholder 120 s instead of 500 + freed key. Read-only, not reproduced, and the only consequence is a CRM retry being 409 for two minutes on a misconfigured deployment -- both codes are 'unknown' to the CRM -- so not raised as a finding; the conservative side is the right side to err on here. (c) 'Full suite 1286 passed' is true only with CRM_EMAIL/CRM_PASSWORD (and CRM_BASE_URL) in the environment; through the shared pytest_docker.sh, the one entry point both sides are supposed to share, the same tree is 2 failed / 1284 passed. Not a 41.2 defect (test_seed_console is untouched), but the claim 'red and green mean the same on both sides' does not hold for this suite as run today. (d) Mutation counts were not re-run by me; I only verified the tests they rely on exercise real code paths (httpx.post stub, real SessionStore counter).
